## Company Overview

Grounded Land Services (GLS) is a Texas-based land clearing and site development company owned and operated by Logan. The company specializes in both Forestry Mulching and Traditional Land Clearing, along with a comprehensive suite of land management and site development services. GLS is licensed, insured, and operated by certified professionals with state-of-the-art CAT equipment including excavators and high-flow mulching heads.

The company's mission is to transform raw acreage into functional, high-value assets using technical knowledge, cutting-edge equipment, and a commitment to eco-friendly practices. Grounded Land Services is known for exceptional attention to detail, honest business practices, timely project completion, and going above and beyond for every client.

## Services Offered

### Forestry Mulching
Advanced single-step land clearing using a high-flow mulching head that grinds unwanted vegetation, brush, and trees into a nutrient-rich organic layer spread directly on the forest floor. No burn piles, no hauling fees. Results in a park-like finish that is immediately accessible while preserving topsoil and root systems of desirable trees. Ideal for wildfire mitigation, pasture restoration, right-of-way maintenance, and land development. More cost-effective and ecologically sound than traditional clearing for many applications.

### Land Clearing (Traditional)
Comprehensive site transformation that delivers a level, seed-ready, stump-free, debris-free finish that is instantly mowable. Ideal for property owners preparing sites for home builds, expanding usable pasture, or creating manicured outdoor spaces. Unlike forestry mulching, traditional clearing removes all material and stumps for a completely clean slate.

### Cedar Tree Removal
Professional removal of invasive cedar species that can consume up to 30 gallons of groundwater per day, starving grass and desirable hardwoods. Cedar removal restores pasture health, increases water availability for livestock and ecosystems, and provides critical wildfire mitigation — cedar's high oil content makes it extremely volatile during fires. Results in enhanced property visibility and long-term property value improvement.

### Rock & Cactus Removal
Removal of large embedded rocks that make land unusable and clearance of invasive cactus species — including Prickly Pear — that overrun pastures and pose dangers to livestock, horses, horses, and people. Equipment handles everything from surface rock clearing to deep root extraction, leaving land clean, safe, and ready for grazing, development, or recreational use.

### Rock Crushing
On-site processing of rock and stone into high-quality usable aggregate using high-performance machinery. Reduces the need to haul in external materials for driveways, pads, and structural foundations. Saves property owners significant cost while preparing land for development.

### Tree Pile Shredding
High-capacity mulching equipment processes large accumulations of downed trees, brush, and woody debris directly on-site. Converts bulky piles into nutrient-rich organic material, improving soil health, suppressing weeds, and reducing fire risk — without burn piles or hauling costs.

### Fence Line Clearing
Removal of dense brush, overhanging limbs, and debris along property boundaries to create clean paths for new fence installation or maintenance of existing borders. Prevents structural damage to fencing and improves property perimeter security and visibility.

### Site Preparation
Precision clearing, debris removal, and expert grading to transform raw land into a construction-ready canvas. Creates a level, stable foundation before the first brick is laid. Essential for residential and commercial builds.

### Underbrushing
Strategic clearing of dense thickets, small invasive trees, and tangled vines while preserving the mature canopy trees above. Removes ladder fuels that allow ground fires to climb into treetops, creating defensible space and wildfire buffers. Results in a park-like environment with improved visibility, sunlight penetration, and soil health.

### Utility Trenching
Specialized excavation of underground pathways for water, electrical, gas, and communication lines to exact depths and widths required by local codes. Ensures utilities are protected from frost, surface pressure, and future damage — installed correctly the first time.

### Dirt Work & Grading
Precision grading, leveling, and soil movement to ensure proper drainage and stable base for any project. Prevents future structural issues, flooding, and erosion.

### Driveways
Construction of gravel, crushed rock, and prepared-base driveways with proper compaction and crowning for long-term durability and effective water runoff management.

### Site Cleanup
Post-construction site restoration — removal of wood scraps, metal debris, and leftover materials, combined with grade restoration, rut leveling, and soil smoothing. Transforms construction sites into pristine, move-in-ready properties.

### Retaining Walls
Engineered walls designed to hold back soil, manage elevation changes, prevent erosion, and convert sloped unusable land into functional level space.

### Demolition
Safe and efficient teardown and complete removal of old structures, leaving the site clean and ready for the next phase of development.

### Additional Services
Rock Removal, Right-of-Way Clearing, Fire Breaks, ATV Trail Creation, Tree & Stump Removal, Tree Pile Mulching, Residential Lot Clearing, Commercial Lot Clearing, Leveling & Grading, Excavation
